status: Accepted OMF FileMobId/MasterMobId owner and association rules; Clip Name and remaining OMF fields under review.

authorization.statement: OK, let's lock those FileMobId and MasterMobId rules in for Bella. Next, how do Media Composer, MDVX and MediaMuster read Clip Name from OMF, and what should Bella read and keep?
authorization.scope: Accepts the prior detailed OMF identity/ownership proposal and plain-language explanation. Begins Clip Name research. No runtime implementation, app cutover, Bin Filter change or final source-priority/header-open decision.

agreedBellaRules.scope: Supported release-one Bento1/legacyOMF1; new selective parser, not runtime adaptation/cutover. No Bin Filter or additional header-open/source-priority decision.
agreedBellaRules.fileOwner: Read active class-qualified MediaData ID and match complete normalized identity to active file mob with supported physical descriptor. Read actual owner MOBJ:MobID; no first/longest/only-candidate guess absent positive physical match.
agreedBellaRules.masterOwner: Qualified active legacy master role (no physical descriptor, usage1/7), complete supported track/component/SourceID relationship to selected file; read own complete MOBJ:MobID. One unambiguously resolved distinct master or unavailable; no mixed metadata from unresolved candidates.
agreedBellaRules.value: Exact supported typed12or32byteID, valid bounds and known required metadata order. Shared approved source-aware normalization. TwelvebyteUID preserves all3words; organization42 known wrapper; unfamiliar organization preserved distinctly. Full32 representation preserves label/instance/material/tail with required4/2/2 field order conversion. No general8byte/partial/nativecompatibility equality.
agreedBellaRules.index: Catalogue UID and local objectref navigate membership; a shortened indexUID is not actual modern full identity. Follow recorded objectref; do not create false equivalence.
agreedBellaRules.availability: Usable file ID survives missing/ambiguous master. Bad required identity or ownership blanks affected OMF contribution while physical inventory and independent eligible facts remain. Equal repeated claims acceptable; contradictory required claims not firstwins. General OMF damage review later. Existing samepath/conflictingID assumption unchanged.
agreedBellaRules.retention: Compact owned binary identities plus necessary availability/relationship context. Existing std::array/QtEndian/QHash full equality approach; release TOC/index/link buffers. No permanent raw graph/header/evidencehistory. Nativeaudio umid not automatically OMFMobID; nativeaudio review later.
agreedBellaRules.kelpieId: Existing samefullpath+samefullFileMobId duplicate ignored; differentpath keepsuniqueKelpieId. Shared MasterMobId nevermergesrows; BinFilterunchanged.
